evidence.summary: Increasing history_score while keeping the other major inputs nearly unchanged consistently lowers the GK-05 score. Query 39 has history_score 350 and score 0.9911, while query 38 has history_score 500 and score 0.9842. Query 18 has history_score 500 and score 0.9597, while query 17 has history_score 700 and score 0.9317.
Increasing linked_badges is associated with a lower score. With the main inputs held constant, score changes from 0.9842 at 18 linked badges to 0.9833 at 19 and 0.9796 at 20.
Adding recent denials lowers the score. Query 21 has recent_denials 0 and score 0.9714, while query 20 has recent_denials 2 and score 0.9663 with the other listed inputs unchanged.

Higher requested_zone is associated with lower score. Queries 31-35 show scores decreasing as requested_zone rises from 35 to 39. Query 25 further drops to 0.9561 at requested_zone 50 compared with 0.9822 at zone 40 in query 26.

Site has a strong effect on the score. For otherwise identical queries, site A gives 0.4335, site B gives 0.0320, site C gives 0.4375, and site D gives 0.4415. Site B is substantially lower than the other observed sites.
Increasing badge_age_days from 25 to 45 lowers the score from 0.9714 to 0.9637 while the other listed inputs remain unchanged.

Changing escorts between 5 and 6 produces little or no score change in the observed high-risk cases: queries 9 and 10 both have score 0.3225 and 0.3538 respectively, while queries 10 and 11 have identical score 0.3538 despite escorts changing from 6 to 5.
